deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.notes: 552B is the nominal backbone count; an additional 196B Engram memory is separately reported. A complete checkpoint total is not established here. deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.notes: 552B is the nominal backbone count; the technical report separately lists 196B Engram parameters (748B nominal combined), while Hugging Face tensor metadata displays 763B for the checkpoint. Active parameters are phase-dependent: 8B per input token during prefill and 16B per output token during decode. The 1017 card links the launch report; its config is byte-identical to the launch config. Context is advertised as 1M; the weights configure 1,048,576 positions.

abacusai/dracarys-llama-3.1-70b-instruct.notes: 70B is nominal; the published BF16 checkpoint contains 70,553,706,496 parameters. Dense model; active parameters are not separately reported. August 14, 2024 is the first checkpoint-upload date, not a verified public-launch date. License conflict: Abacus card declares Llama 3, while its named Llama 3.1 base declares Llama 3.1. Model config allows 131072 positions, but tokenizer model_max_length is 2048. Fine-tune-specific reasoning-mode and tool-call support remain unverified.

ai21/jamba-large.description: AI21's Jamba Large 1.7, a text-only hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for long-context instruction following and grounded generation
ai21/jamba-large.notes: Reviewed alias target: jamba-large-1.7-2025-07. Counts are AI21's nominal 398B total / 94B active; public tensor metadata counts 398,555,145,696 parameters. Context 256000 normalizes the advertised 256K, not an independently verified exact implementation limit. Weights require acceptance of custom license conditions. Dedicated reasoning-mode status remains unverified.

alibaba/qwen2-5-vl-72b-instruct.notes: 72B is the nominal label; the complete BF16 checkpoint has 73.410777344B parameters, including 0.704573696B in the visual encoder and merger. Active parameters are not separately defined. Context 128000 follows the shipped model positional configuration; tokenizer length 131072 is a preprocessing setting. The card describes 32768 and optional YaRN, and the report documents 32768 training sequences, so configured context does not establish long-text quality. A dedicated reasoning-mode boolean remains unverified.

alibaba/qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-instruct.notes: Full checkpoint: 31,070,754,032 parameters including vision components. alibaba/qwen3.5-0.8b.description: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling, intended for prototyping and task-specific fine-tuning.

alibaba/qwen3.5-122b-a10b.notes: Full checkpoint: 125.086497008B tensor parameters, including vision and MTP weights. Qwen reports a nominal 122B language model with 10B active; active count applies to the language decoder. Native context is 262,144 tokens.

alibaba/qwen3.5-27b.description: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling
alibaba/qwen3.5-27b.notes: Complete checkpoint: 27.781427952B parameters, comprising 26.895998464B language model including embeddings/output head, 0.460730096B vision and 0.424699392B MTP. alibaba/qwen3.5-2b.description: Post-trained Qwen3.5 vision-language model with dense feed-forward layers, hybrid attention, optional thinking and tool calling.

alibaba/qwen3.5-35b-a3b.notes: Open weights released February 24, 2026; Alibaba’s API listing is dated February 23. alibaba/qwen3.5-35b-a3b-base.notes: Full checkpoint: 35.951822704B stored parameters, including vision and MTP. alibaba/qwen3.6-max-preview.description: Proprietary text-only preview in the Qwen3.6 series, with thinking mode and function calling for coding and agentic tasks.
alibaba/qwen3.6-max-preview.notes: Earliest documented release is the International listing on April 14, 2026; the Qwen announcement is April 18 and China listing April 20. The undated preview identifier has no verified immutable checkpoint equivalence. Counts and architecture remain undisclosed. Context and tool support rely partly on complete indexed primary pages whose live content has changed; current endpoint operation was not tested.

alibaba/qwen3.6-35b-a3b.description: Open-weight multimodal Qwen MoE supporting text, image and video input, text output, reasoning and tool calling.
alibaba/qwen3.6-35b-a3b.notes: Full checkpoint: 35.951822704B stored parameters including the vision encoder and auxiliary MTP. The model card reports nominal 35B total and 3B activated for the language model; 3B is not a full multimodal/MTP active count. Official weight availability is dated April 16, 2026; the Alibaba Cloud article is April 17. The checkpoint has an April 15 commit labelled Initial public release, which does not independently establish its historical visibility.

alibaba/qwen3.6-plus.description: Alibaba Qwen model for agentic coding and multimodal understanding, with a one-million-token context window.
alibaba/qwen3.6-plus.notes: Model Studio lifecycle tables explicitly record April 1, 2026 availability, preceding the April 2 launch announcement and snapshot label. The current alias is documented as equivalent to qwen3.6-plus-2026-04-02. Exact-model parameter counts, architecture and weight license are undisclosed in the reviewed primary materials; open-weight status remains unverified.

alibaba/qwen3.7-flash.description: Qwen3.7 vision-language model supporting text, image, and video inputs, text output, thinking mode, and function calling, with a 1,000,000-token context window.
alibaba/qwen3.7-flash.notes: July 21, 2026 is the earliest explicit Model Studio release-table date found in both Beijing and Singapore; July 15 is the named snapshot date. A partially indexed console shows an unlabeled July 20 date, whose meaning/timezone remains unresolved. Total/active parameters, dense/MoE architecture, weight availability, and weight license are not established for this exact variant. Official pricing maps the alias to the July 15 API snapshot, without mapping it to open weights.

alibaba/qwen3.7-max.notes: Qwen3.7-Max is proprietary; total/active parameter counts and internal architecture are not disclosed in the reviewed exact-model primary documents. The qwen3.7-max alias is documented as equivalent to the text-only May 20 snapshot; the separate June 8 snapshot adds vision. Earliest explicit regional release is May 20, 2026 in Global scope in Virginia, Hong Kong and Frankfurt; China and Singapore list May 21.
alibaba/qwen3.7-max.description: Text-only Qwen3.7 model for coding and agent tasks, with a one-million-token context window, thinking mode, and function calling.

alibaba/qwen3.7-plus.description: Qwen3.7 multimodal model with a 1M-token context, text, image and video inputs, thinking mode, and function calling for coding and agent workflows.
alibaba/qwen3.7-plus.notes: The alias maps to qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26; June 1 is the documented public release. The later official Flash-Next Language comparison table explicitly reports 397B parameters and 17B active for Qwen3.7-Plus. These are nominal language-model counts; complete hosted components are not quantified. Internal architecture, exact-model weight availability and weight license remain unverified.

alibaba/qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b.description: Open-weight text-only reasoning model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated attention and sparse MoE layers. The full checkpoint includes a multi-token prediction module; the hosted Qwen3.8-Max version adds further features.
alibaba/qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b.notes: Full BF16 checkpoint: 2446.182725504B parameters, comprising decoder 2419.804697984B and auxiliary MTP 26.37802752B. The official 2.4T/95B labels are nominal language-model figures; 95B active applies to the decoder, not an asserted MTP-inclusive inference total. Hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated-attention MoE; 262,144 native context, extendable to 1,010,000.

alibaba/qwen3.8-27b.description: Dense Qwen3.8 vision-language model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, configurable reasoning, and tool calling.
alibaba/qwen3.8-27b.notes: Complete BF16 checkpoint: 27.781427952B parameters, including 26.895998464B language model plus output head, 0.460730096B vision, and 0.424699392B MTP. The published 27B is nominal. A later official comparison table explicitly reports 27B nominal active language-model parameters; this excludes an asserted all-modality/MTP execution total. Native context is 262,144 tokens; extension to 1,000,000 is documented.

alibaba/qwen3.8-flash.notes: 125B is the nominal main model count, with 51B N-gram embeddings separately disclosed and 6B nominal active main-model parameters. Full hosted deployment total is unspecified. Alibaba calls Flash open-weight and explicitly links Flash-Next as the released weight counterpart under Qwen Community License 1.0; its card maps hosted Flash as the production version with added features. Exact hosted internals and the released checkpoint are not asserted identical; Flash-Next MTP counts are not imported. API service terms are separate from the weight license. PDF input is supported in Beijing/Singapore via Chat Completions/DashScope, not Responses.

alibaba/qwen3.8-flash-next.description: Open-weight multimodal MoE preview of Qwen4, combining Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention with a vision encoder, n-gram embeddings, and MTP. The complete BF16 checkpoint contains about 180B parameters; the main language model activates a nominal 6B per token.
alibaba/qwen3.8-flash-next.notes: Complete checkpoint count is 179,999,981,424 BF16 parameters, excluding 35 I64 indexing values. Official nominal 125B main + 51B n-gram + 4B MTP labels are component descriptions, not an exact independent-tensor breakdown. Stored MTP tensors total 2.607150848B and configuration disables dedicated MTP embeddings, so shared tensors are counted once. The nominal 6B active count concerns language-model computation and excludes n-gram lookup storage. Native context is 262144; hosted Qwen3.8-Flash adds a default 1M context. August 26 is the explicit official release date; August 27 is the Cloud article date.

alibaba/qwen3.8-max.notes: Alibaba directly reports nominal 2.4T total / 95B active for hosted Qwen3.8-Max, with sparse MoE and hybrid attention; these are not exact checkpoint tensor counts. Since September 5, 2026 the endpoint maps to qwen3.8-max-0902; August 3 remains the original non-preview release. The open Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B checkpoint is text-only and the hosted model adds vision and non-thinking support; complete hosted-weight availability and license mapping remain unverified. PDF input is supported through Chat Completions/DashScope, not Responses. API callability was not tested.

alibaba/qwen3.8-max-0902.notes: 2.4T is Alibaba's nominal hosted Max total, linked to 0902 through its documented endpoint mapping; it is not a complete tensor census. PDF input is supported in Beijing/Singapore through Chat Completions, not Responses. Exact weight-release status and a corresponding weight license remain unverified.

alibaba/qwen3.8-max-preview.description: Hosted Qwen3.8 preview for reasoning, coding and professional tasks, with a one-million-token context and text, image and video input; later retired in favor of Qwen3.8-Max.
alibaba/qwen3.8-max-preview.notes: 2.4T is a nominal total published for the exact preview by Alibaba/Qoder. Preview active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed in the inspected primary sources; later GA/checkpoint 95B/MoE details are not transferred. Historical capabilities describe the preview; current documentation says its ID routes to Qwen3.8-Max. The retirement notice gives inconsistent August 5/6 timing, so no exact retirement timestamp is asserted. Exact weight-release status and a corresponding weight license remain unverified.
